quests.title: ...What Do Adventurers Do Again?

dialogue.t: Was there anything else?

dialogue.sit: Have you found that sword of yours?

dialogue.t: ...Huh, to think you still remember that. Unfortunately, no. I still don't have the foggiest idea where it might be.
It seems I'm still at square one, waiting for things to happen.
If anything related to that matter crops up, I might come looking for you — When that happens, I'll be counting on you.
A—Are you an adventurer? Are you here to accept commissions?
Uh, please... wait a moment, let me see what I have here... "Speed Glider," "Outdoor Survival Experience Guide," "Free Climbing Instructor Wanted..."

dialogue.sit: That doesn't sound like the Adventurers' Guild...

dialogue.t: I know, and Lan says so too! But all the adventures I've read about in books were something like this...
If I don't give out these commissions, what should I give out, then...
I—Isn't that dangerous? I mean, there are a lot of them around Lisha, and they are a threat to passers-by.
But normal people don't stand a chance against them. They might even get hurt...

dialogue.sit: Well then, leave it to me.

dialogue.t: Can you really? Well.. Alright then, I'll leave it in your hands. I'll go back and discuss appropriate payment for your services with Lan.
Do all adventurers do these dangerous things?
But what if they get injured...
Eh? You're back already? Have you completed the commission?
That's... really impressive. I went back to the Guild to reorganize our commissions based on the one I gave you.
There was a whole mountain of commissions related to defeating monsters. So adventurers are supposed to do this sort of thing all the time...
But other than monsters, there've been reports that say that Treasure Hoarders have been seen along the roads.
Is this really also something the Adventurers' Guild should do? It feels like it falls under the job scope of the Millelith...
Huh. Adventurers can really do anything, it seems.
Well then, I will prepare adequate compensation for you — so please take this commission, too!
What, another one already? We haven't gotten our...
There'll be further compensation! I've already discussed this with Lan. So as long as you complete the next commission, you'll receive further payment.

dialogue.sit: Well, that sounds more like it.

dialogue.t: I'll be counting on you, then.
Well, that's two commissions down.
The secret method Lan taught me to "get adventurers to take commissions gladly" really works...
I'll leave it to you then, adventurer!
The secret method Lan taught me to "get adventurers to take commissions gladly" really works...
Have you finished the commissions?
Wow... So this is the strength of an adventurer.
Well, um, if you don't mind, could you answer some of my questions about adventurers and commissions?
Other than defeating monsters, what other commissions do adventurers take?

dialogue.sit: We also help people fix carts and houses.
We help people pick flowers and catch fish.
We send takeout and play with children.

dialogue.t: Whoa, doesn't that just mean that you adventurers do everything? I never knew.
Thank you! I'll make note of it for sure... Ah yes, right. This is your repayment, please take it. It's as generous as can be, you know!
Next time you're here to take commissions from me, I'll make sure to give you the best ones!

quests.description: At Lan’s direction, Tiantian of the Adventurers’ Guild has been put in charge of distributing commissions, but she has no idea what sort of commissions she should be giving out to adventurers…
